name: license-manager-linux-subscriptions
description: With License Manager, you can discover and track your commercial Linux subscriptions on running Amazon EC2 instances.

subcommands.name: deregister-subscription-provider
subcommands.description: Remove a third-party subscription provider from the Bring Your Own License (BYOL) subscriptions registered to your account.

subcommands.name: get-registered-subscription-provider
subcommands.description: Get details for a Bring Your Own License (BYOL) subscription that's registered to your account.

subcommands.name: get-service-settings
subcommands.description: Lists the Linux subscriptions service settings for your account.

subcommands.name: list-linux-subscription-instances
subcommands.description: Lists the running Amazon EC2 instances that were discovered with commercial Linux subscriptions.

subcommands.name: list-linux-subscriptions
subcommands.description: Lists the Linux subscriptions that have been discovered.

subcommands.name: list-registered-subscription-providers
subcommands.description: List Bring Your Own License (BYOL) subscription registration resources for your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List the metadata tags that are assigned to the specified Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: register-subscription-provider
subcommands.description: Register the supported third-party subscription provider for your Bring Your Own License (BYOL) subscription.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add metadata tags to the specified Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove one or more metadata tag from the specified Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: update-service-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the service settings for Linux subscriptions.
